editorial:
Imagine you are a high-flying ad man in New York City who has everything except a real relationship. That is exactly where you find the main character in this flick. He is a total womanizer who thinks he has it all figured out, but he quickly realizes his obsession with sex is actually holding him back. The vibe is a mix of late-90s city energy and romantic chaos. You will see him struggle through a funny yet honest journey as he tries to change his ways just to win over a woman he actually respects. It is a lighthearted look at how hard it is to break old habits when you are finally ready to grow up.

The acting feels natural, and the pacing keeps you moving along without any boring stretches. You might find some of the jokes a bit dated since it came out in 1999, but the core message still hits home. If you enjoy stories about people learning to be better versions of themselves, you will love this. Since it is an older title, your best bet is to look for a high-quality stream on Prime Video or rent it on Apple TV for a crisp picture. If you are a movie buff who loves physical media, adding the Blu-ray to your collection is a great way to keep this gem forever.
endingExplained: After a lot of trial and error, the main character finally stops treating people like trophies. He has a heart-to-heart with the woman he loves and proves that he has actually changed his mindset. He lets go of his ego and his need for constant validation from strangers. In the end, they decide to give their relationship a real shot, showing that honesty and self-control are the only ways to find true love.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves 90s rom-coms and stories about personal growth.
